findings.current: Team Leader Choi was already charging the thing, as if he’d been sure the passage wouldn’t break.
findings.defect: The English says the passage itself would not break. The source says Choi acted as though he already knew the blocked route could not be breached or opened.
findings.rationale: 통로가 뚫리지 않을 거라는 사실 refers to the blockage being impossible to break through, not to the passage remaining physically unbroken.
findings.replacement: Team Leader Choi was already charging the thing, as if he’d known we wouldn’t be able to break through the blocked passage.

summary: The chapter is faithful overall, with one minor physical-mechanism error in the description of the blocked passage.
